title: UserProfileEnforcementActionRestriction
description: Anthropic has limited how it serves the end user until the action is resolved. The end user may still be served in part.

id.description: The action's ID (`enac_...`), stable while the action is open.

reason.description: Why Anthropic placed the limit: `unsupported_region`, `fraud_or_abuse`, `high_harm`, `usage_policy_violation`, `account_compromise` or `unspecified`.

action.description: The next step on the action: `verify` or `null`. `verify`: the end user can clear it now by passing an identity check. `null`: there is nothing the end user can do now to clear it, including while Anthropic reviews an identity check the end user submitted.

opened_at.description: When Anthropic opened the action, in RFC 3339 format.

expires_at.description: When the action ends on its own, in RFC 3339 format; it stops showing once this time has passed. `null` when it has no end date, and always `null` when `reason` is `account_compromise`.
